name: Corrected VolPFN native five-density tail comparison
prior_exposure: The later panel (2015–February 2022) was inspected before this study. This is a new frozen comparison on an exposed panel, not an untouched confirmation.
checkpoint_family: Corrected broad final checkpoints from the GJR-repaired five-seed study, 20,000 updates; not the distinct component-ablation full models or historical-trained models.

inference.convention: Same within-window normalisation and overlapping-window ownership as programme_closure/evaluate.py. Each target t uses only positions before t. Regenerate mixture parameters only, with fixed weights; no training, tuning or scale calibration.
inference.prefix: No forecast at index zero. Retain native forecasts from index one to initialise the online guard; all scored dates have at least 100 previous returns.

combination: Normalise each seed component weights to unit sum, then divide by five and concatenate the four components per seed into one 20-component density. Do not average VaR, ES or scores.

tails.sign: Lower-return tail; negative VaR and ES
tails.root: Bracket by min/max individual component alpha-quantiles and bisect the combined CDF; tolerance 1e-11 in raw percentage-return units.
tails.es: Sum w*(mu*T_nu(z) - scale*(nu+z*z)/(nu-1)*t_nu(z)), divided by alpha; Gaussian branch uses mu*Phi(z)-scale*phi(z).
tails.validation: Single Gaussian and Student-t unit tests before scoring; numerical integration checks on deterministic first/middle/last eligible rows of each market at every alpha. CDF residual <1e-9, ES integration tolerance 2e-7 absolute plus 2e-7 relative.

scoring.units: 100 times decimal open-to-close log returns (percentage units)
scoring.comparator_policy: Use archived Chapter 7 original daily scores, with their historical optimiser acceptance policy; do not refit or silently replace them with convergence-checked sensitivity results.
scoring.matching: Exact market/date alignment across native, guard, GARCH FHS, GARCH-t, GAS and neural t8; require all 28 markets and all saved panel dates. No silent row dropping.
scoring.mean: Mean within market, then equal mean over 28 markets.

bootstrap.p: Two-sided fraction across zero, minimum 1/2000; same original implementation and joint calendar resampling.

primary.beats: Negative mean and Holm p <0.05, unless the 95% interval includes zero, which is a tie. Positive significant intervals are labelled worse; otherwise no adjusted evidence.

secondary.development: All five contrasts at every level, unadjusted.
secondary.diagnostics: Native and native guard: per-market hit counts/rates, central binomial 95% band using n=int(mean matched panel days), as Chapter 7; also actual-market-n band. Report Christoffersen independence LR (1 df) and joint conditional-coverage LR (2 df), unadjusted p<0.05, rejection counts out of 28; use <= for hits and successive observed market sessions.

guard.initialisation: Run causally from the first available native forecast (index one); no invented day-zero prediction or fallback. This differs by one initial observation from historical comparators. Keep and disclose it. All scored days follow warmup.

deviations: Record any deviations or numerical/backend limitations separately. Never edit this frozen protocol. Stop on unavailable checkpoints or incomplete/nonfinite matched forecasts.
